name: A Gypsy's Tale: The Tower of Secrets
summary: Reylin of Winderalth is a mysterious gypsy called upon by a monk to help investigate a cursed tower. The tower holds many secrets including a reason behind the disappearance of its princess. There isn't much time, the curse is spreading. Help Reylin avoid traps and solve complex puzzles in a bid to restore order to the land. When this is done the tower's secrets will finally be clear.
